program:
app "Scrabble" board ink
table point team pick Amina|Bilal, pts num 1..500 = 1
let a = sum(point.pts where team = Amina)
let b = sum(point.pts where team = Bilal)
setting winat num = 300 "Play to"
row gap 2
  stack card grow align center
    "Amina" bold
    a big
    button "+1" tap add point team = Amina, pts = 1
    row gap 1
      button "+2" tap add point team = Amina, pts = 2
  stack card grow align center
    "Bilal" bold
    b big
    button "+1" tap add point team = Bilal, pts = 1
    row gap 1
      button "+2" tap add point team = Bilal, pts = 2
button "Undo" tap remove last(point)
button "New game" tap remove all point
"Lead:" abs(a - b) faint
if a >= winat
  "Amina win!" head color good
if b >= winat
  "Bilal win!" head color good
describe:
Scrabble, in the ink colours.
Keeps:
- point: team: one of Amina, Bilal; pts: number, 1 to 500, starts at 1. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: "Play to": number, starts at 300.
Works out:
- a is the total pts of point where team is Amina.
- b is the total pts of point where team is Bilal.
Shows:
- text: "Amina".
- text: a.
- a button "+1"; a tap adds a point with team set to Amina, pts set to 1.
- a button "+2"; a tap adds a point with team set to Amina, pts set to 2.
- text: "Bilal".
- text: b.
- a button "+1"; a tap adds a point with team set to Bilal, pts set to 1.
- a button "+2"; a tap adds a point with team set to Bilal, pts set to 2.
- a button "Undo"; a tap removes the latest point entries, with undo.
- a button "New game"; a tap removes all point entries, with one undo.
- text: "Lead:", a minus b without its sign.
- if a is at least winat:
  - text: "Amina win!".
- if b is at least winat:

program:
app "Spinner" game plum
state ang num = 0
state spun num = 0
draw 100, 100 width 240 tap set ang = random(360) then set spun = spun + 1
  each 0..5 as s
    arc 50, 50, 44, s * 60, s * 60 + 60 fill hue(s * 60) opacity 0.8
  circle 50, 50, 6 fill ink
  line 50, 50, 50 + 40 * sin(ang), 50 - 40 * cos(ang) stroke ink thick 3
"Landed on slice" floor(ang / 60) + 1 big
"Spins" spun faint
describe:
Spinner, in the plum colours.
Remembers while you use it: ang, starting at 0; spun, starting at 0.
Shows:
- a drawing made of arcs, circles, lines; a tap sets ang to a random whole number from 1 to 360, then sets spun to spun plus 1.
- text: "Landed on slice", ang divided by 60 rounded down plus 1.
- text: "Spins", spun.
